reason: opcov defect (same root as #34): the last line of a multi-line unqualified `preg_replace(...)` call in a namespace. PHP compiles the arguments twice, for the frameless call and for the `JMP_FRAMELESS` fallback that looks up `Symfony\Component\String\preg_replace`. The frameless copy carries `''` and `$s` in the `OP_DATA` of `FRAMELESS_ICALL_3`, which runs no handler of its own, so line 555's only probed opcodes (`SEND_VAL_EX`, `SEND_VAR_EX`) are in the fallback, which never runs. Raw Xdebug and PCOV also report the line not covered; php-code-coverage marks it covered because it marks every line of a statement once one ran (`markExecutableLineByBranch`). No test can cover it.

Xdebug 3.5.3 artifact: the file's only block (`return [...]`) ran in `ByteStringTest::testWidth#3`, the test both drivers attribute line 12 to, but Xdebug reports its branch `hit` as 0 because the file is `require`d from inside a method (`self::$tableWide ??= require ...` in `AbstractUnicodeString::wcswidth`). The same file required from top-level code reports `hit` 1. Not a coverage gap.

Same Xdebug artifact as wcswidth_table_wide.php: the only block ran in `ByteStringTest::testWidth#3` (line 12 covered for both drivers), required from `AbstractUnicodeString::wcswidth`, and Xdebug reports the branch as never hit.

opcov defect (same root as #34): `max(..., $length ?? ...)` is an unqualified frameless call in a namespace, so PHP compiles the `??` twice, in the `JMP_FRAMELESS` fallback and in the frameless path. The tests take both outcomes of the frameless copy; the fallback copy never runs and its `CoalesceValue` and `CoalesceFallback` are reported as unseen. No test can take them. Xdebug counts the fallback blocks under the `Engine` row.
